question: Nina has more paint rollers than her brother Karl. She started with 17 rollers and threw away 11 that were worn out. The rest were shared equally between the 6 rooms she was decorating, and the kitchen's allocation is the one to follow. For the second coat she ordered 9 rollers for every roller allocated to the kitchen. Karl then ordered 4 rollers for each of those, so the whole house would be covered. The shop quotes drying times in hours although the tins are labelled in minutes. How many rollers are in the final order?

A vineyard picked 147 baskets of grapes, and each basket filled 9 bottles. A neighbour contributed 46 bottles, and the cellar turned up 47 more from last year. The bottles were divided evenly into 2 equal cellars, and the west cellar is the one being followed. A distributor then ordered 4 bottles for every bottle in the west cellar. How many bottles does that order come to?

On Monday morning a nut factory had 104 sacks of almonds, and a lorry delivered 70 more before noon. In the early afternoon each sack was tipped into 6 barrels. Later that afternoon every barrel was divided into 7 tubs. In the evening each tub was filled out into 5 jars, and overnight every jar was portioned into 3 sachets. How many sachets did the factory end up with?

A guitar teacher printed 45 booklets, and each booklet contained 9 exercises. The proofreader struck out 23 exercises that had misprints. A colleague then contributed 46 new exercises. The teacher produced a version of the whole book for each of the 4 grades she teaches, using that many exercises in every version. Her studio holds 16 students at a time, and lessons are advertised in hours although she bills them in minutes. How many exercises are there across all the versions together?

Kofi collects more postcards than his friend Marta. He bought 74 albums, and each album already held 5 postcards. Marta gave him 62 postcards from a holiday, and a market stall added 38 more. A collectors' club then arranged a swap that left Kofi with 6 postcards for every postcard he owned. Half of his desk is buried under the collection, and the club lists postage in dollars although the stall prices everything in cents. How many postcards does Kofi have now?

A community kitchen had 63 jars of jam, and a volunteer brought in a dozen more. The jars were shared equally between the 5 lunch clubs, and the harbour club's share is the one to follow. A supermarket then matched the donation, giving the harbour club 4 jars for every jar in its share. The club later divided its jars equally between its 4 tables, and the corner table's share is the one being counted. The kitchen serves 80 meals a week, and it prices its jam in dollars although the labels are printed in cents. How many jars are on the corner table?

A cinema had 144 free passes for Saturday morning. By noon 129 passes had been claimed at the box office. In the afternoon 6 passes were withdrawn as forgeries, and 2 more were lost. In the evening the chain reissued the surviving passes for each of its 8 screens, printing that many passes per screen. The cinema seats 220 people. How many passes were printed altogether?

A council nursery had 118 trays of saplings, and 69 trays went out to the parks. A donation added 39 trays. Each tray was then split into 3 pots, and every pot was later divided into 6 seedlings. Storm damage killed 558 seedlings, and 299 were given away on community planting day. The nursery has 14 greenhouses, and it measures growth in centimetres although its reports are written in metres. How many seedlings are left?

Rania stocks more soap than her business partner Jonas does. She ordered 182 cases, and each case held 4 boxes. Every box was then opened out into 3 gift sets. Jonas added 22 gift sets from his workshop, and a customer returned 4 more. The sets were shared equally between the 5 shops in the group, and the market square shop's share is the one being followed; Jonas sent 27 extra sets to that shop. The group quotes delivery times in hours although the couriers record them in minutes. How many gift sets does the market square shop have?

A rowing club had 53 oars in the boathouse. A regatta took 34 oars away for the weekend, and 15 more were sent off for repair. The club then bought 4 oars for every oar still in the boathouse. The oars were finally split evenly between the club's 2 racks, and the upper rack's share stayed for training. The boathouse is 26 years old. How many oars are on the upper rack?

A recycling depot took in 134 sacks of bottle tops on Monday, and a school collection matched the haul exactly, leaving the depot with 2 sacks for every sack it had. The sorters threw out 115 sacks of contaminated material. Each sack still in the yard was then tipped into 6 bins for colour sorting. The bins were finally shared equally between the 6 art clubs on the depot's list, and the pottery club's share is the one being followed. How many bins does the pottery club get?

On Tuesday morning a comic shop unpacked 102 boxes, and each box held 5 bundles of comics. During the afternoon every bundle was broken open into 7 single comics. In the evening the comics were shared equally between the chain's 3 shops, and the high street shop's share is the one to follow. A collector then sold 52 comics to the high street shop. How many comics does the high street shop have?

A fireworks factory made 100 crates for the festival, and each crate held 8 boxes. Every box was packed with 6 tubes, and each tube contained 7 rockets. The rockets were shared equally between the 6 display sites, and the harbour site's share is the one being followed. During the show 3684 rockets were fired from the harbour site. Half of that site was fenced off for safety, and 250 stewards worked the festival. How many rockets are left at the harbour site?

Petra grows more pumpkins than her brother Lukas does. She brought 240 pumpkins to the autumn market, and the stallholder cut each one into 7 wedges. During the day 106 wedges were sold. Lukas contributed 38 wedges from his own crop, and a neighbour added 78 more. The market runs for 12 hours. How many wedges are on the stall at the end?

Amara knits more squares each month than her friend Rosalind does. She bought 131 skeins of wool, and each skein made 5 squares for a blanket. Rosalind gave her 3 finished squares, and a knitting group donated 48 more. A charity then asked for that same blanket to be made for each of the 8 shelters it supports, needing that many squares for every shelter. How many squares are needed altogether?

A hotel laundry started the week with 118 sets of bed linen, and 12 sets came back from the repair room. A guesthouse that was closing down sold the hotel 44 more sets. The owner then bought in enough new linen for the hotel to hold 2 sets for every set counted so far. Over the summer 312 sets were worn out and thrown away. How many sets of bed linen does the hotel have?

On Monday morning a rail depot had 101 trolleys, and each trolley carried 6 parcels. Before noon a van added 53 parcels, and a corner shop handed over 19 more. In the early afternoon 43 damaged parcels were taken out of the pile. Later that afternoon a post office sent over 27 parcels. In the evening head office ran that same round in each of the 5 districts it serves, sending that many parcels to every district. The depot quotes delivery windows in hours although the drivers record their stops in minutes. How many parcels went out across all the districts?

Selma bottles more cider than her cousin Iker does. She pressed 185 barrels, and each barrel filled 7 casks. A leak lost 63 casks, and a pub chain bought 809 of them. A festival took another 337 casks, and Iker later returned 21 casks refilled from his own press. The cellar is kept at 12 degrees, and the trade lists volumes in litres although the casks are stamped in millilitres. How many casks does Selma have now?

Jonah keeps more chess sets in his club store than Beatriz keeps in hers. He counted 177 sets, and a school donated 34 more. Beatriz passed him 29 sets she no longer used. A tournament sponsor then supplied 4 sets for every set in Jonah's store. A late parcel added 7 further sets, and the club room holds 60 tables. How many sets are in Jonah's store now?

On Thursday morning a button factory ran 153 spools, and each spool produced 8 buttons. Before lunch 314 buttons failed the shine test and were scrapped. In the early afternoon a second machine was switched on, leaving 2 buttons for every button made so far. Later that afternoon the plating line turned out 5 buttons for each of those. In the evening a supplier delivered 40 spare buttons. Overnight 1329 buttons were shipped to a clothing firm, and the factory floor covers 900 square metres. How many buttons are in the factory now?

A swimming club had 62 lane floats in its store. The council donated 38 floats, and 61 floats were sent off to the summer camp. A neighbouring club lent 53 floats for the gala, and a sponsor supplied 66 brand-new ones. How many floats are in the club's store now?

Halima takes more stall space at the craft fair than her colleague Rui does. She began the season with 239 wooden toys, and her workshop delivered 57 more. Rui handed over 36 toys he had not sold. A department store then placed an order that took her book to 4 toys for every toy she held, and a catalogue firm followed with one that took it to 5 toys for each of those. A school added a final order of 80 toys. The firm quotes production times in weeks although the workshop plans in days. How many toys are in Halima's order book?

A theatre workshop had 184 metres of cable in store, and 12 metres were cut away as frayed. A supplier delivered 16 metres, and a theatre that was closing donated 47 metres. The company then ordered the same length again for each of its 4 touring sets, needing that much cable per set. How many metres of cable does the company need altogether?

A tool library had 85 drills on its shelves, and a donation added 9 more. Members borrowed 55 drills, and 30 were sent away for servicing. A grant then paid for 7 drills for every drill still on the shelf. A hardware chain donated 20 further drills, and the library opens 4 days a week. How many drills are on the shelf now?

A watchmaker had 67 movements in his drawer, and 28 of them were sold to a collector. Each movement still in the drawer needed 4 tiny springs. The supplier sent 3 springs for every spring on that list, to allow for breakages. The springs were divided evenly into 2 equal boxes, and the workshop box is the one being followed. During the year 54 springs from that box snapped, and the shop has been trading for 90 years. How many springs are in the workshop box?
